tagline: Houses well thought out for the climate, light and life of Latin America
description: DAI is a magazine about design, architecture and interiors for homes in Latin America: distribution, materials, natural light, thermal comfort, kitchens, bathrooms and patios explained with criteria and without fads.
author: DAI Editorial

arquitectura-y-casas.name: Architecture and houses
arquitectura-y-casas.description: Distribution, orientation, ventilation and structure: how to think of a house that works in the climate where it is built.

interiores-y-decoracion.name: Interiors and decoration
interiores-y-decoracion.description: Color, furniture, textiles, lighting and order for spaces that feel spacious, warm and personal.

cocinas-y-banos.name: Kitchens and bathrooms
cocinas-y-banos.description: Planning, materials, storage and maintenance of the two rooms that are most used and cost the most to renovate.

materiales-y-acabados.name: Materials and finishes
materiales-y-acabados.description: Brick, concrete, wood, adobe, ceramic, stone and paints: what each one offers, how long it lasts and how it is cared for.

patios-y-exteriores.name: Patios and exteriors
patios-y-exteriores.description: Patios, terraces, balconies and gardens: shade, plants, exterior floors and outdoor living spaces.

confort-y-sostenibilidad.name: Comfort and sustainability
confort-y-sostenibilidad.description: Heat, humidity, noise, water and energy: passive and efficient solutions to live better while spending less.
